title: An affine contractible extension valid on every full small pro-etale site
statement: Let A be a commutative ring in universe u. There exist a commutative ring D in the same universe and a ring homomorphism phi : A -> D such that the singleton Spec(D) -> Spec(A) is a pro-etale covering [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. Moreover, for every scheme X [def-pc-scheme] and every weakly etale map g : Spec(D) -> X [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism], every epimorphism F -> G of sheaves valued in Type (u+1) on the full small pro-etale site of X [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] is surjective on evaluation at Spec(D) -> X. Spectra are as in [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with universes as in [def-weil-size-convention].

source.place: Stacks Tags 0983, 098H and 0990, source-library exists_isWContractibleRing in RingTheory/ProEtale/WContractible.lean and isWeaklyContractible_of_iso in AlgebraicGeometry/ProEtale/WeaklyContractible.lean

proof.text: Apply the already proved source-library theorem exists_isWContractibleRing to A. It gives a commutative ring D : Type u, an A-algebra structure, ind-etaleness, faithful flatness and IsWContractibleRing D. Set phi = algebraMap A D. No cardinal arithmetic is needed: this theorem constructs D in the same universe as A. This source theorem was checked by #print axioms to use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.

RingHom.IndEtale.weaklyEtale and WeaklyEtale.Spec_iff make Spec(phi) weakly etale. The faithfully-flat spectrum criterion makes Spec(phi) surjective. Its source and target are affine, so it is quasi-compact. Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage now proves that the singleton spectrum map is in proetalePrecoverage. This argument also applies to the zero ring.

Let X be any scheme and g : Spec D to X any weakly etale map. Apply the already proved isWeaklyContractible_of_iso to the identity isomorphism of Spec D, with its IsWContractibleRing instance. The resulting IsWeaklyContractible predicate is for sheaves on the full small pro-etale site of X, in Type (u+1). Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi turns an arbitrary epimorphism e into the local-surjectivity hypothesis of that predicate, giving surjectivity on evaluation at ProEt.mk g. The proof uses no nontriviality assumption. The source theorem was checked by #print axioms to use only the three allowed axioms.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affine_contractible_extension (A : Type u) [CommRing A] :
    ∃ (D : Type u) (_ : CommRing D) (φ : A →+* D),
      Presieve.singleton (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ∈
        proetalePrecoverage (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) ∧
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (g : Spec (CommRingCat.of D) ⟶ X) [WeaklyEtale g]
        (F G : Sheaf (topology X) (Type (u + 1))) (e : F ⟶ G),
        Epi e → Function.Surjective (e.hom.app (op (ProEt.mk g))))
